page_title: SEV 5-1 ALM | Sevilla v Almeria 26/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Guillermo Cuadra is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+2' 5 - 1 Kike Salas (Sevilla) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes inside the right post. He couldn't have done it any better. 5:1.
90+1' Erik Lamela (Sevilla) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Almeria comes to nothing.
89' Corner kick. Almeria will have an opportunity.

89' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Almeria have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
88' The ball has crossed the sideline. Almeria are taking a throw-in.
86' Iddrisu Baba Mohammed (Almeria) receives a yellow card for infringement.
86' The ball goes out of play and Almeria have been awarded a corner kick.
85' The attendance for today's match is 35729.
84' Jose Luis Mendilibar decides to make a substitution. Adria Pedrosa will be replaced by Kike Salas (Sevilla).
84' The game has come to an end for Youssef En Nesyri. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Rafa Mir (Sevilla).
84' Suso (Sevilla) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
82' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
81' Luis Suarez (Almeria) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
81' Vicente Moreno prepares a substitution. Alejandro Pozo is replaced by Houboulang Mendes (Almeria).
80' Erik Lamela (Sevilla) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
79' The Almeria players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
77' A yellow card for a tackle by Kaiky (Almeria). Guillermo Cuadra doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
76' Jose Luis Mendilibar has decided to substitute Jesus Navas and he is replaced by Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla).
72' The substitution is prepared. Leo Baptistao (Almeria) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Sergio Arribas.
71' 4 - 1 Goal! Orjan Nyland gets a hand on the penalty from Luis Suarez (Almeria), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom left corner.
71' Luis Suarez (Almeria) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
70' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
70' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) makes a strong challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows for a foul. The referee gives a penalty kick to Almeria!!
69' The Almeria players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
68' The corner lands on the head of Kaiky (Almeria) in the middle of the box and he tries to guide his header into the far right corner, but it's misjudged and goes well wide of the right post.
67' The ball is out of play. Almeria will have a chance to score from a corner.
67' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Almeria force their opponents to concede a corner.
65' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Djibril Sow as he is replaced by Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla).
65' Substitution. Dodi Lukebakio leaves the pitch and is replaced by Boubakary Soumare (Sevilla).
64' Vicente Moreno has decided to make a change. Kaiky (Almeria) replaces Cesar Montes.
64' Here is a change. Dion Lopy is going off and Vicente Moreno gives the last tactical orders to Largie Ramazani (Almeria).
63' Substitution. Arnau Puigmal (Almeria) has come on for Ibrahima Kone.
59' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
56' Goal! No, wait. It's disallowed for a foul by Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla).
55' Alejandro Centelles Plaza (Almeria) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
54' Sevilla fail to score from a corner as Luis Maximiano (Almeria) leaps to collect the ball.
51' 4 - 0 Goal! Adria Pedrosa plays it to Erik Lamela (Sevilla), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Luis Maximiano. 4:0.
50' Loic Bade (Sevilla) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. Almeria win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
49' Half-chance! Erik Lamela (Sevilla) plays a pass into the box, but Luis Maximiano reacts well to snuff out the attack.
47' The foul by Iddrisu Baba Mohammed (Almeria) was seen by Guillermo Cuadra who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) wins himself enough space to connect with a cross inside the box, but his fine header goes narrowly over the crossbar!
45+2' Ibrahima Kone (Almeria) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
45+1' The ball is out of play and Sevilla manage to earn a corner.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' It looks like Luis Suarez (Almeria) saw red with that tackle. Guillermo Cuadra won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
44' The resulting set piece from Sevilla is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

44' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Luis Maximiano pulls off a brilliant save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Sevilla.
43' Suso (Sevilla) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is out of play. Almeria will take a throw-in.
42' Good chance! Sergio Arribas (Almeria) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
38' 3 - 0 Suso (Sevilla) latches on to a superb pass and breaks through the defence before firing a shot from mid-range that goes past the goalkeeper inside the left post.
38' Ibrahima Kone (Almeria) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes well over the bar.
37' A player from Sevilla pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
33' A cross by Dion Lopy (Almeria) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
30' Almeria keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
26' Luis Suarez (Almeria) makes a rough challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul.
25' The corner from Suso (Sevilla) is hurriedly cleared.
25' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Sevilla earn a corner.
24' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
23' A cross from Alejandro Pozo (Almeria) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
22' The ball goes behind for a corner. Sevilla will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

21' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot towards the roof of the net. His promising effort is kept out by Luis Maximiano, who pulls off a stunning save! The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Sevilla.
21' Sevilla seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
18' Ibrahima Kone (Almeria) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
18' Iddrisu Baba Mohammed (Almeria) is penalised for holding. Guillermo Cuadra signals a set piece.
17' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Erik Lamela (Sevilla), whose header flies narrowly wide of the right post.
17' Suso (Sevilla) takes the corner but it's cleared.
16' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The ball is out of play. Sevilla win a corner kick.
15' The corner is floated into the centre of the box, but a placed header from Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) flies well wide of the right post.
14' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Sevilla.
14' The referee blows his whistle, Sevilla are awarded a corner kick.
14' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick.
13' Sergio Arribas (Almeria) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
12' Luis Suarez (Almeria) commits a foul and Guillermo Cuadra immediately signals a free kick.
11' Almeria are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
8' 2 - 0 Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Luis Maximiano with a strike into the top left corner. He makes it 2:0.
7' 1 - 0 An unlucky rebound falls to Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) and he scores with a bullet header.
7' Loic Bade (Sevilla) latches on to the corner kick inside the box, but his header crashes against the crossbar! The goalkeeper would have been helpless.
7' Sevilla will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
5' Sergio Arribas (Almeria) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
3' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Almeria.
2' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Ibrahima Kone (Almeria) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Sevilla will have the kick-off.
